name: af3_jax_predict
description: Predict an all-atom biomolecular structure with AlphaFold 3 (the open JAX fork) on public OpenFold3-preview2 weights. Give either 'sequences' -- a simple list of chains, which is run MSA-free -- or 'fold_input', a complete AlphaFold 3 fold-input JSON carrying your own MSAs and templates. No alignment is built here and no external service is contacted. Returns per-sample confidence scores ranked best-first; the mmCIF text itself is opt-in.

sequences.description: The chains of one complex, run MSA-free. Mutually exclusive with 'fold_input'.

sequence.description: Residue sequence, or SMILES when molecule_type is 'ligand'.

chain_ids.description: Chain labels; defaults to A, B, C... Give several to place identical copies.

fold_input.description: A complete AlphaFold 3 fold-input JSON object (dialect 'alphafold3'). Use this when you have real MSAs or templates: every protein chain needs 'unpairedMsa', 'pairedMsa' and 'templates', where an empty string means MSA-free and null means 'the data pipeline will fill this', which this provider does not run.

seed.description: Random seed; replaces 'modelSeeds' in a supplied fold_input. The same seed reproduces the prediction.

num_diffusion_samples.description: Structures to sample per seed (upstream's default is 5). Each is scored separately, so this is how to compare conformations. Changing it recompiles the held model.

num_recycles.description: Trunk recycling iterations (upstream's default is 10). Fewer is faster and less accurate. Changing it recompiles the held model.

return_structures.description: Return the mmCIF text (default false: megabytes per sample). The confidence scores come back either way.
